standard-dialogue.npc: Greetings Bwana! My name is Yanni and I buy and sell antiques.

options.text: Tell me about this antiques business.

steps.player: Tell me about this antiques business.

steps.npc: I buy antiques and other interesting items. If you have any interesting items that you might want to sell me, please let me see them and I'll offer you a fair price.
Would you like me to have a look at your items and give you a quote?

steps.text: If the player doesn't have an item Yanni can buy:

steps.npc: Sorry Bwana, you have nothing I am interested in.

steps.text: If the player has the Bone key in their inventory:

steps.npc: I'll give you 100 coins for the Bone Key...

steps.text: If the player has the Stone-plaque in their inventory:

steps.npc: I'll give you 100 coins for the Stone Plaque...

steps.text: If the player has the Tattered scroll in their inventory:

steps.npc: I'll give you 100 coins for the tattered scroll...

steps.text: If the player has the Crumpled scroll in their inventory:

steps.npc: I'll give you 100 coins for the crumpled scroll...

steps.text: If the player has the Locating crystal in their inventory:

steps.npc: I'll give you 500 coins for your locating crystal...

steps.text: If the player has the Beads of the Dead in their inventory:

steps.npc: I'll give you 1000 coins for your 'Beads of the Dead'...

steps.text: If the player has only one of the above items:

steps.npc: And that's the only item I am interested in. If you want to sell me that item, simply show it to me.

steps.text: If the player has more than one of the above items:

steps.npc: Those are the items I am interested in Bwana. If you want to sell me those items, simply show them to me.
Sure thing. Have a nice day Bwana.

options.text: Do you have any interesting items for sale?

steps.player: Do you have any interesting items for sale?

steps.text: If the player already has the Beads of the Dead in their inventory or bank:

steps.npc: Sorry, [Sir/Madam], I have nothing that you need.

steps.text: If the player does not have the Beads of the Dead:

steps.npc: Fair enough, come back if you change your mind.

using-antiques-on-yanni-bone-key.npc: That's a great bone key. Here's 100 coins for it.

using-antiques-on-yanni-crumpled-scroll.npc: That's a great crumpled scroll. Here's 100 coins for it.

using-antiques-on-yanni-tattered-scroll.npc: That's a great tattered scroll. Here's 100 coins for it.

using-antiques-on-yanni-bervirius-notes.npc: That's a great copy of Bervirius notes. Here's 100 coins for it.

using-antiques-on-yanni-locating-crystal.npc: That's a great Locating Crystal. Here's 500 coins for it.

using-antiques-on-yanni-stone-plaque.npc: That's a great stone-plaque. Here's 100 coins for it.

using-antiques-on-yanni-beads-of-the-dea.npc: Impressive necklace there, here's 1000 coins for it.

using-antiques-on-yanni-black-prism.npc: Ah you'd like to sell this to me would you? I can offer you 5000 coins!

steps.player: Yes, I'll sell it for 5000 coins.

steps.npc: Very well my friend, let me count out your reward.

options.text: No, I think I'll hold on it a while longer yet.

steps.player: No, I think I'll hold on it a while longer yet.

steps.npc: Very well my friend, come back if you change your mind.
